findings.rationale: Independently recalculated all event times, signs, speeds, heights, horizontal table entries and trajectory coefficient using constant-acceleration equations.

Full German and English task, solution and rubric review; six subtasks and 36 independent one-point criteria per task sum to 36, with passing threshold 22. Equivalent methods and consistent carry-forward are explicitly allowed.
Criteria 6.5 and 6.6 now permit equivalent kinematic arguments for equal impact speed and different flight times; the illustrated 3-second return is not the only accepted method.

Signed scalar coordinates require no vector calculations or total-speed construction. Equal fall times are limited to the ideal model; air resistance may alter vertical motion but is not claimed to couple directions or change arrival order in every possible drag model.

Only assessed model competencies are mapped; no practical-experiment, free-fall experiment, horizontal-experiment or vector-superposition competency is certified. Requires describe entry knowledge and may differ from assessed coverage.
